dish.note: Egyptian fava bean falafel in flatbread with tahini sauce and pickles.
dish.how: Soak 400g dried split fava beans (or chickpeas) overnight, drain and blitz with 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 bunch each of parsley and coriander, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander and 1 tsp salt to a rough green paste. Rest 10 minutes, shape into 16 patties, shallow fry in 2cm of oil at 180C for 3 minutes a side until deep golden. Stuff 4 flatbreads with the ta'amiya, tahini sauce (4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water to loosen), tomato and pickles.

ingredients.item: dried split fava beans, soaked overnight

steps.text: Drain the soaked beans and blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin, coriander and salt to a rough paste.
Rest the paste, then shape into 16 patties.
Shallow fry in 180C oil, 3 minutes a side, in two batches.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, 1 crushed garlic clove and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with ta'amiya, sliced tomato, pickles and tahini sauce.

dish.make_ahead: Soak the beans the night before; the paste can be made 4 hours ahead and fried just before serving
